Results.ReviewText: I  have had a Weber Kettle grill for over 50 years and love cooking with charcoal.  I did notice this new Kettle grill has changed, some for the better like plastic handles instead of wood handles.  the two negatives are the lack of two handles so that you are able to lift the grill to move when you can't roll the grill and the other is that the new grill lacks the ability to add charcoal when using the rails for indirect cooking like roast or ribs.  Also the top grill is not as the quality as old grill'
Results.Title: Pros and Cons of the new Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Made bleu cheese stuffed steaks for the inaugural meal and they were fabulous!  I bought my brother one of these grills and he has grilled on one ever since.  Only way to grill.
Results.Title: Best decision for the current stay-at-home world!

Results.ReviewText: Purchased the original Kettle Charcoal grill necause of a recommendation from a friend. I definitely love the grill for what it is. The reason why I only gave 4 stars is because i think it really should have a seal around the lid so when you cover the it the heat and smoke is better contained. Other than that, it is an awesome grill! It is made with great material and was very easy to put together. I've only had it for almost 3 weeks and i've smoked 3 racks of ribs, 2 whole chickens and a roast. It has worked like a champ. I really wish it had a seal around the lid and a grate that's able to be folded up to add charcoal on the sides but I guess you can't expect much when it's only $109. I'll find a seal and another grate so it will be the perfect grill!
Results.Title: Great grill!!

Results.ReviewText: Best in class. Doesn't get better than a webber kettle
Results.Title: to legit to quit

Results.ReviewText: owned 3, 2  22"s and the baby weber. Best grill for the money. Last a many years of great grilling. Easy to use. My #1 Choise!

A work horse, and people love my charcoal cooking. Plus add in the years my dad had the same one, and I've pass my old one to my son.

Results.ReviewText: Worth it. I suggest spending the extra 60ish dollars to get the other Weber 22 with the ash catcher and something else. But love the grill, used it today.

Results.ReviewText: Grill itself is great. The lid handle assembly for mine did not have long enough screws therefore there is no handle on the top of my lid making use of the lid absolutely impossible. After two emails to Weber and only automated responses, my $109 grill sits on my deck not being used as grilling without something to smother pop up flames is a disaster....yes I tried and putting the lid ON a heated grill was no problem. Taking it OFF....ha! The lid was super hot and it was a fiasco worthy of recording to blackmail me.
Results.Title: Great grill, not a great handle assembly

Results.ReviewText:
love the webb cooker,it is so much easier to work and to create quality edible good looking food for the table, the reason i didnt give the full five stars id this.. the top grill has a bent edge  that came with the box it was packed in. It works  and I would "tweak" it back but then it would break completely then. fortunately it does not affect the purpose it was designed for but it still looks bad.other than the fact it shows some true "quality care" and or attitude problem with the packing folks the rest of the cooking device is superb.
bob king
